meta_title: ALKOTBAN Agricultural Materials Import | Misrata, Libya
meta_description: ALKOTBAN for Importing Agricultural Materials — a Libyan company based in Misrata, sourcing fertilizers, pesticides, seeds and soil conditioners from trusted international suppliers.
hero_heading: Connecting Libyan farms to the world's trusted agri-supply sources
hero_subheading: We import and coordinate the supply of fertilizers, pesticides, seeds and soil conditioners from certified international suppliers, tracking every shipment from origin to Misrata.
trust_bar_two: Products selected against strict quality standards
trust_bar_three: Years of experience in the Libyan agri-market
trust_bar_four: Commercial and logistics support on every shipment
trust_bar_five: Long-term relationships with suppliers and clients
about_heading: ALKOTBAN — the link between global suppliers and Libyan farms
about_paragraph_one: ALKOTBAN for Importing Agricultural Materials is a Libyan company based in Misrata, specializing in importing and distributing fertilizers, pesticides, seeds and soil conditioners from trusted international sources. We act as the link connecting manufacturers and suppliers worldwide with farmers, traders and distributors across the Libyan market.
about_paragraph_two: We select our products carefully to suit Libya's soil and climate, and follow every shipment from the moment it's contracted until it reaches the client — keeping supply consistent and quality steady, season after season.
about_quote: We believe trust in agriculture is built shipment by shipment, season after season.
about_image_alt: ALKOTBAN warehouse and agricultural material shipments
categories_description: Everything a farm or distributor needs, from a single trusted source — from the soil to the harvest.
category_fertilizers_desc: A wide range of compound, organic and liquid fertilizers covering every stage of crop growth.
category_seeds_desc: Vegetable and forage seeds from trusted global breeders, selected to suit Libya's growing conditions.
category_pesticides_desc: Carefully selected insecticides and fungicides that protect yield and reduce crop loss.
category_supplies_desc: Growth regulators, soil conditioners, irrigation supplies and supporting solutions, in a catalog we're continuously expanding.
vertical_step_one_description: We source from certified international suppliers to guarantee reliable specifications on every shipment.
vertical_step_two_title: Deep expertise in the Libyan market
vertical_step_two_description: Our understanding of Libya's climate and terrain guides which products we bring to each region.
vertical_step_three_description: Our team is available to guide product use and answer client questions.
vertical_step_four_description: We coordinate shipping and customs clearance so every order arrives on schedule.
vertical_step_image_alt: Illustration of the benefits of working with ALKOTBAN
network_description: We build direct relationships with manufacturers and suppliers in key markets worldwide, selecting each one for quality and reliability, to keep supply steady for our clients in Libya.
network_footnote: We continue to expand our international supplier network in line with Libyan market needs.
process_step_one_desc: We listen to your farm or project requirements — crop type and the quantities needed.
process_step_two_desc: We recommend the products and formulations best suited from our certified international sources.
process_step_three_desc: We coordinate with suppliers to secure the quantities, specifications and timing required.
process_step_four_desc: We track the shipment from the port of origin until it reaches Misrata.
process_step_five_desc: We deliver the product and stay in touch to support your next season.
quality_heading: Standards we hold before a product reaches you
quality_intro: We select our suppliers and products against clear criteria, and follow every shipment closely to make sure it arrives to the agreed specification.
quality_pillar_one_desc: We work with manufacturers and suppliers with a proven track record in their markets before any product joins our catalog.
quality_pillar_two_desc: We verify that every shipment matches the specifications and quantities agreed before delivery.
quality_pillar_three_desc: We stay in touch with our clients after delivery to follow performance and provide support when needed.
product_vegetable_seeds_clause_desc: Diverse selections of high-quality seeds that meet all your farm's needs. Discover European innovation and quality in every seed, ensuring the best crops and high productivity with Clause's globally distinguished varieties.
product_alfalfa_seeds_sw_desc: High-quality Imperial alfalfa seeds from American S&W, withstand various conditions and ensure abundant, healthy yields with increased agricultural productivity.
product_alfalfa_three_cows_desc: Original American alfalfa seeds (Three Cows) from AlfaGen Company - high quality and efficiency for your farms.
product_zaszko_dutch_seeds_desc: Zaszko Dutch Company seeds specialized in high-performance vegetable varieties. Dutch quality to ensure maximum productivity and resistance in your farm.
product_carbini_tomato_desc: Hormonal growth regulator with 5% PCPA concentration, its role enhances fruit setting and reduces flower drop, significantly improving crop productivity such as tomatoes and legumes.
product_senator_extra_desc: Good chemical compound that works in a distinctive and unique way on most insects in vegetable crops. Active ingredient: Diafenthiuron 50% SC.
product_solution_pesticide_desc: Insecticide specialized in controlling agricultural pests of spider type, providing absolute control over these harmful pests that infect vegetable crops, comes in a 100ml package.
product_admiral_extra_desc: Insecticide for protecting agricultural crops from pests, providing effective defense that ensures healthy growth and higher productivity.
product_five_multi_desc: Balanced gel formulation to support vegetative growth, used at concentration of 0.5-2 g/L, works efficiently with calcium, magnesium and microelements to improve nutrient absorption and plant growth.
product_torofort_gel_desc: (TOROFERT) - Saudi manufacturing with global quality. A new generation of fertilizers that provides concentrated and effective plant nutrition. Features soluble gel consistency to ensure maximum absorption and best results, produced by Target Level Company.
product_grogreen_belgian_desc: Wide range of NPK formulations with superior Belgian quality from LIMA Company. We provide the ideal formulation for each growth stage, ensuring complete nutrition and abundant crops.
product_cocoly_desc: Water-soluble granular fertilizer that nourishes plants from roots to fruits, activates roots, enhances element absorption, balances soil acidity, and strengthens plants for better growth and larger yield thanks to its unique biological composition and patented polymer acid.
product_organic_birds_desc: Features very high content up to 70% of organic matter, making it ideal for improving soil structure and fertility, and enhancing its ability to retain water and nutrients.
partners_description: We're proud of our relationships with specialist fertilizer, seed and crop-supply companies across multiple international markets, each selected to keep quality consistent for our clients in Libya.
